achievements.name: Into the Pit
achievements.detail: Drop into the pit, fire bouncing balls at the enemy rows, and finish the opening dive.

achievements.name: Region Boss
achievements.detail: Defeat the boss that closes out a region before the horde overruns you.

achievements.name: Fused Shot
achievements.detail: Combine two fully leveled balls during a dive so one shot carries both of their effects.

achievements.name: Evolved Ball
achievements.detail: Satisfy an evolution recipe during a dive and fire the new ball it creates.

achievements.name: Harvest Run
achievements.detail: Send a hero across New Ballbylon and collect wheat, wood, or stone from the tiles they hit.

achievements.name: Fields and Trees
achievements.detail: Place a wheat field and a forest in town and harvest both.

achievements.name: New Hero
achievements.detail: Raise the building that recruits another treasure hunter and take that hero into the pit.

achievements.name: Blueprint Built
achievements.detail: Carry a building blueprint out of a dive and construct that building in New Ballbylon.

achievements.name: Deeper Region
achievements.detail: Unlock a region past the first and clear its waves through the boss.

achievements.name: Level-Up Pick
achievements.detail: Collect enough experience in a dive to choose a new ball or a passive upgrade.

achievements.name: Endless Dive
achievements.detail: After a region's boss falls, stay in the pit and survive the waves that follow.

achievements.name: Final Region
achievements.detail: Clear the last region the pit can open, boss included.
